subject: Vendr portal attribute ownership — sync and claim process
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Vendr Support <support@vendr.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr portal attribute ownership — sync and claim process

Marissa / Kim —

Quick heads-up: while preparing Northbridge's CAIQ mapping for their SIG, I noticed a set of ~12 fields in their Vendr profile are showing as "unclaimed" (steward = empty) even though Northbridge's questionnaire points to their asset team as the owner. The attached CSV (caiaq-attribute-diff-20270530.csv) is a diff between our CAIQ mapping and what Vendr currently displays.

This is blocking the customer from finalizing a proof-of-possession bundle — they need ownership asserted in Vendr or a short handoff artifact we can attach (example: presigned S3 link + brief attestation). Northbridge's assessment deadline is Friday EOD PT, so we have a tight window.

Can you triage ownership changes and decide whether we (a) request Vendr to assign those fields to Northbridge's steward, or (b) accept the attestation file they can upload and document the difference in our evidence log? If (a) we should open a Vendr case and include the CAIQ control IDs; if (b) we need a standard attestation template.

Next steps I suggest:
- Marissa: confirm whether we can accept attestation artifacts as interim evidence for SIG/Caiq items.
- Kim: if we need Vendr action, please open a ticket with support and include the CSV + example screenshot.

I'm adding Vendr Support on CC so they can advise on the fastest path to claim ownership programmatically or via the UI.

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Onboarding Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: caiaq-attribute-diff-20270530.csv (csv, 24 rows)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Vendr Support <support@vendr.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal attribute ownership — sync and claim process

Thanks Markus — good catch.

Short answer: we can accept a signed attestation as interim evidence for the CAIQ fields, but only if the attestation includes:
- explicit field list (names + CAIQ/SIG control IDs)
- name/title of the signing authority at Northbridge
- timestamped statement of ownership and where the evidence is stored (S3/GDrive)

Operationally: I prefer we pursue both tracks in parallel — ask Vendr to reassign the steward where possible and collect an attestation for anything they can't reassign before Friday. That preserves the customer's audit posture.

Kim — can you open a Vendr support ticket and ask for the steward bulk-claim API or admin UI steps? If they can do a backend reassign, request an activity log entry as proof. Put VENDR ticket ID in the case so we can reference it in the security portal.

I’ll draft a one-page attestation template and drop it in the shared Drive folder (link below).

Marissa
Vendor Reliability Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Related: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExample/CAIQ-mapping

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@northbridge.com>

Cc: Vendr Support <support@vendr.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal attribute ownership — sync and claim process

Hi Markus / Marissa / Kim —

Thanks for flagging this. We did a recent reorg in our asset inventory team last week and it's likely the owner fields didn't map over in Vendr. I attached a screenshot from our admin view (vendr-claim-screenshot-20270531.png) showing the missing steward.

We prefer Vendr to reassign the fields if possible because that keeps the evidence chain intact in the portal. If Vendr needs a signed attestation, we can produce one immediately. For the reassignment flow, can you confirm:
1) Does Vendr require a CSV with resource IDs + new steward email?
2) If so, what's the column schema?
3) If not, can Vendr do the change on your behalf and provide an activity log?

We're under time pressure for the SIG submission — appreciate quick guidance.

Best,
Sarah Lee
Security Operations Manager
Northbridge Financial

Attachment: vendr-claim-screenshot-20270531.png (PNG, 1 file)

--- Forwarded message from Vendr Support <support@vendr.com> ---
From: Vendr Support <support@vendr.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@northbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:40:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: steward reassignment request - Northbridge

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for reaching out. We can perform a bulk steward reassignment if you provide CSV with the following columns: resource_id, field_name, new_steward_email, requested_by. Alternatively, if you are a Vendr admin, the UI supports bulk claim under Settings > Asset Owners > Bulk Upload. We will also generate an activity log entry for any backend changes.

If you want us to perform the change, please attach the CSV and reply to this thread. If you upload via UI, send us a screenshot of the completed upload and we'll issue the log entry.

Support
Vendr Inc.

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Kim Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@northbridge.com>, Vendr Support <support@vendr.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal attribute ownership — sync and claim process

Great — thanks Sarah and Vendr Support. Plan:

1) Kim: please open ticket VENDR-12452 (assign to platform-tools queue) and paste Vendr's CSV schema. Ask them to perform the backend reassign and provide the activity log entry. Use the attached caiaq-attribute-diff-20270530.csv as the basis; Northbridge will fill the new_steward_email column.

2) Marissa: I put a draft attestation template in the Drive folder. If Vendr cannot complete the backend change for any of the rows, we'll accept a signed attestation for those specific field IDs and attach it to the CAIQ evidence bundle.

3) Sarah: when Northbridge completes the CSV with new_steward_email, reply-all with the file and mark any rows that are "not eligible" for reassign (we'll handle those with attestation).

Timeline: aim to have the reassign/attestation completed by Thu COB PT so we can finalize the CAIQ by Friday.

I'll track the ticket and update the account's evidence log. Thanks everyone for moving quickly.

-Markus
Head of Onboarding Operations
Redwood Inference
